summary: Declare reactive state whose reads and writes are ordinary variable syntax, rewritten to signal accessor calls.

capabilities.requirement: Rewrite reads and assignments of a declared reactive binding into accessor calls.
Declare macros and ordinary syntax together in one replacement.
Name a generated rule's pattern variables outside any template repetition.
Derive the storage name from the declared name and publish it to following code.
Claim the assignment that follows a generated name so a write becomes a set.

syntaxNotes: `state name = value;` declares the storage and a macro named for the binding.
A read of the name becomes a get; every assignment operator becomes a set.
A logical assignment keeps its short circuit, writing only when it would.
An assignment is an expression whose value is what it wrote.
Only the declared name is rewritten; every other binding is untouched.
`effect { ... }` registers a body that re-runs when a signal is set.
